map.：工薪税 T = 10000 × (0.20 + 0.08) = 2,800 元: Payroll tax T = 10000 x (0.20 + 0.08) = 2,800 CNY, of which the employer bears 2000 and the employee 800.
map.：若合计率降到 24%，则税 = 10000 × 0.24 = 2,400 元，: If the combined rate falls to 24%, the tax = 10000 x 0.24 = 2,400 CNY, saving 400 CNY versus 28%.
